style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit Snowy Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>A really cosy Christmas classic, this Snowy Pre-Lit Indoor Garland brings a touch of the winter landscape inside. At 1.5m long, the garland features an abundance of faux fir foliage flocked with a snowy effect and is entwined with warm white LEDs on a green cable to give a beautiful sparkle to the branches. </p><p>Arrange this garland across the mantlepiece and display the Snowy Pre-Lit Indoor Wreath above. Or display the garland along a crisp white tablecloth with silver cutlery and ivory TruGlow® Pillar Candles for a festive tablescape.</p><p>To illuminate, simply insert 3 AA batteries into the battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the 6-hour timer function for an automatic shine at the same time each evening. You should expect 30–50 hours of illumination time from your batteries before they will need refreshing.</p><ul><li>(W) 1.5m</li><li>Lead Wire: 10cm</li><li>50 LEDs</li><li>Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)</li><li>Indoor Battery Decoration</li><li>Optional 6-hour timer</li><li>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat, and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look</li><li>Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions</li><li>Size: ONE</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: A really cosy Christmas classic, This Snowy Pre Lit Indoor Garland brings a touch of the winter landscape inside. At 1.5m long, the garland features an abundance of faux fir foliage flocked with snowy effect and is entwined with warm white LEDs on a green cable to give a beautiful sparkle to the branches. Arrange this garland across the mantlepiece and display the Snowy Pre Lit Indoor Wreath above. Or display the garland along a crisp white tablecloth with silver cutlery and ivory TruGlow® Pillar Candles for a festive tablescape. To illuminate, simply insert 3 AA batteries into the battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the 6-hour timer function for an automatic shine at the same time each evening. You should expect 30 – 50 hours of illumination time from your batteries before they will need refreshing. (W) 1.5m Lead Wire: 10cm 50 LEDs Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) Indoor Battery Decoration Optional 6-hour timer All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions. Size: ONE.
